name: @synergic-apis/mcp

tools.name: get_us_inflation_latest
tools.description: Get the most recent month of official US inflation (CPI-U, Bureau of Labor Statistics) for all 11 categories at once: headline all-items, core, energy, food, housing, apparel, transportation, medical, recreation, education-communication and other. Each point has the index level plus year-over-year and month-over-month percent change computed exactly like the BLS. Use this to answer "what is US inflation right now?".

adjusted.description: false (default) = not seasonally adjusted (NSA, the year-over-year convention the press quotes); true = seasonally adjusted (SA, the month-over-month convention).

tools.name: get_us_inflation_history
tools.description: Get monthly CPI history for one category (headline "all-items" goes back to 1913). Returns index level and YoY/MoM percent per month, most recent first. Paginated by period range: if meta.next_end is not null, call again with end = meta.next_end for older data. Note: October 2025 was never published by the BLS (federal shutdown) and is absent.

category.description: CPI category. "all-items" is headline inflation; "core" excludes food and energy.

end.description: Inclusive end month (YYYY-MM). Pass meta.next_end here to get the next page.

adjusted.description: false (default) = not seasonally adjusted (NSA, the year-over-year convention the press quotes); true = seasonally adjusted (SA, the month-over-month convention).

tools.name: get_us_inflation_annual
tools.description: Get the official annual average CPI of one category (the BLS M13 rows, published NSA only). Headline "all-items" covers every year since 1913 — with limit=150 the complete series fits in one call. Ideal for long-run inflation comparisons and "how much has $X in year Y grown" questions.

category.description: CPI category. "all-items" is headline inflation; "core" excludes food and energy.

end.description: Inclusive end year (YYYY). Pass meta.next_end here to get the next page.

limit.description: Max points per page (1-150, default 50; 150 = the whole headline series).

tools.name: get_famous_prices
tools.description: Get famous US average consumer prices in dollars from the BLS: eggs (per dozen), gasoline (per gallon), milk (per gallon), bread (per lb), ground-beef (per lb), coffee (per lb) and electricity (per kWh). Without "item" it returns the latest price of the whole basket. With "item" it returns that item's monthly history (gasoline since 1976), paginated by period range (use meta.next_end as the next "end").

item.description: One item for monthly history. Omit to get the latest price of every item.

start.description: Inclusive start month (YYYY-MM). Only used with "item".

end.description: Inclusive end month (YYYY-MM). Only used with "item"; pass meta.next_end to paginate.

limit.description: Max points per page (1-100, default 30). Only used with "item".

tools.name: get_us_debt_latest
tools.description: Get the current US national debt to the penny — the most recent official U.S. Treasury "Debt to the Penny" record: total public debt outstanding plus its two components (debt held by the public and intragovernmental holdings), in US dollars exact to the cent. Use this to answer "what is the US national debt right now?".

tools.name: get_us_debt_history
tools.description: Get US national debt history from the U.S. Treasury. frequency="daily" returns the Debt to the Penny series (every business day since 1993-04-01, components null before 2005-03-31; limit up to 100). frequency="annual" returns debt outstanding at each fiscal year end since 1790 — with limit=250 the complete 235-year series fits in one call. Most recent first; paginate by passing meta.next_end as the next "end".

frequency.description: "daily" = business-day Debt to the Penny (1993+); "annual" = fiscal-year-end series (1790+).

end.description: Inclusive end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pass meta.next_end here to get the next page.

limit.description: Max records per page. Daily: 1-100 (default 30). Annual: 1-250 (default 100; 250 = whole series).

tools.name: get_us_interest_rates
tools.description: Get the average interest rates the U.S. Treasury pays on the national debt (monthly, 2001+). Without "security_class" it returns the latest rate of all eight classes: total, marketable, non-marketable, bills, notes, bonds, tips and frn. With "security_class" it returns that class's monthly history, paginated by period range (periods are month-end dates; use meta.next_end as the next "end").

security_class.description: One security class for monthly history. Omit to get the latest rate of every class.

start.description: Inclusive start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only used with "security_class".

end.description: Inclusive end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only used with "security_class"; pass meta.next_end to paginate.

limit.description: Max records per page (1-100, default 30). Only used with "security_class".

tools.name: get_my_usage
tools.description: Check the monthly usage and remaining quota of the configured Synergic APIs key: plan name, requests used, monthly limit and when the quota resets. Call this when a request fails with a quota error or the user asks how much of their plan is left.

instructions: Official US economic data from Synergic APIs (synergicapis.com): US inflation (BLS CPI, history to 1913), famous average prices (eggs, gasoline, milk…) and the US national debt (Treasury, daily to the penny, annual to 1790) plus Treasury interest rates. All amounts are JSON numbers; periods are YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. History tools paginate by period range: pass meta.next_end as the next "end" argument.
